critique.good: Most compact (252px) and the rhythm is even: all four body rows are 60px, so rows read as units. No mid-word splits; 说明 at 185px holds most notes in 2 lines; three of four quantity names sit on one line.
critique.problems: The 公式 column is the weakest link: at 90px (69px of text) the 91px formulas break after the equals sign, so 万有引力 renders as “F =” over “G·m₁m₂/r²” — the definition reads as two fragments, and the reader's cross-row scan of formulas (the column that should be compared vertically) is broken. Meanwhile 理想气体状态方程 wraps in col 1, and 说明 gets only two lines for the longest note.
critique.cause: col 3 is 90px, 1px short of the 112px needed to keep the 91px formula tokens whole; col 1 at 100px is 44px short of the 144px that holds 理想气体状态方程. Both 符号 and 单位 sit at 52px with 21px of pure slack each, so the budget is being spent in the wrong place.

critique.good: Gives 说明 the most air (209px), so prose is comfortable at 2 lines and the table reads calmly on the right-hand side. Headers all stay on one line.
critique.problems: Row identity collapses on the left: 万有引力 breaks as “万有引 / 力” and 理想气体状态方程 needs 3 lines, so the eye cannot grab a quantity name in one fixation. Every formula is split after “=” (公式 86px = 65px of text vs 91px needed). Result is the tallest of the three (299px) with ragged left column — the worst of both worlds.
critique.cause: col 1 squeezed to 80px (needs 81px even for 万有引力 alone, 144px for the long name) and col 3 squeezed to 86px, while col 5 is over-fed at 209px — roughly 40px past the point where the longest note stops needing a third line.

critique.good: The technical block is perfect: all quantity names on one line (144px), all formulas on one line (112px), so rows 1–4 read left-to-right as complete statements. This is the cleanest interpretation of the content.
critique.problems: The prose column is starved: 说明 at 119px (98px of text) forces 3–4 lines, with orphan fragments like “能量。” and “约” stranded on their own lines. Row heights jump 83/83/106 and the table stretches to 368px — a short lookup table turned into a tall document. The vertical rhythm is destroyed and the prose no longer reads as sentences.
critique.cause: col 1 takes 144px (only 123px of content, 21px slack) and col 3 takes 112px (only 91px, 21px slack); those two maxed-out widths leave 说明 with the remainder. Since 说明's longest line is 274px, anything under ~140px forces 3+ lines.

critique.good: The most even vertical rhythm of the three: every body row is 60px, so the table reads as a steady stack of equal units. 符号/公式/单位 are given exactly what they need (52/112/52), all formulas, symbols and units sit on one line, and 理想气体状态方程 breaks cleanly 4/4 rather than mid-word.
critique.problems: The last row's note ends with an orphan: 静止质量对应的能量。 breaks as 静止质量对应的能 / 量。, leaving a two-character line dangling in the widest column — the most visible flaw in the render. At the same time the name column looks slightly padded relative to how tight the prose is.
critique.cause: col5 = 167 leaves 146px of text, about 4px short of the 150px that 静止质量对应的能量。 needs, so one character is pushed to a second line; meanwhile col1 = 96 gives 75px of text where 4 CJK characters (60px) already fill a line, so ~15px of the name column is slack that the prose column needed.

critique.good: Cleanest typography: col5 = 175 gives 154px of text, so 静止质量对应的能量。 fits on one line (no orphan), row 2's G ≈ 6.674×10⁻¹¹ / N·m²/kg² breaks at the space into value and unit, and row 3 breaks at the space between the constant and 8.314. Compact 252px table, no mid-word splits, headers all single-line.
critique.problems: The row rhythm collapses at the bottom: rows 2–4 are 60px but the final row is only 36px, so the table looks pinched under row 3 and the last entry reads as less important than it is. The name column is also at its tight limit.
critique.cause: Because col5 = 175 is just wide enough to fit the shortest note on one line, that row auto-shrinks to a single 36px line while every other note needs two; col1 = 88 leaves only 67px of text, barely one 4-character line, so 理想气体状态方程 has almost no slack.

critique.good: The name column is comfortable — 理想气体状态方程 wraps 4/4 with visible air — and formulas/units are still exact and unbroken.
critique.problems: The note column is visibly ragged: row 3's note breaks into three lines (R 为摩尔气体常 / 数，约 8.314 / J/(mol·K)。), splitting the constant from its unit and inflating that row to 83px; the table grows to 299px and the last row still orphans 量。. The table looks unbalanced — a wide left column and a squeezed right column.
critique.cause: col5 = 155 leaves 134px of text (short of the 150px needed for the last note and far short of what row 3 needs), while col1 = 108 gives 87px of text for names whose longest line only needs 60px — about 20px of width is taken from the column that is starving and given to the one that has surplus.

critique.good: 物理量 at 90px breaks 理想气体状态方程 into a clean 4+4; 符号 and 单位 are stable at their minimum; every formula and unit token stays intact; no header wraps.
critique.problems: 说明 at 173px is just under the width needed to keep the short last note on one line, so all four body rows become two-line 60px rows and the table grows to 275px. 公式 at 112px is exactly at its one-line threshold, leaving no breathing room around the math.
critique.cause: The 173px 说明 column directly causes the extra row height; 112px 公式 is the minimum that fits the 91px longest formula, so any tighter width would split a formula.

critique.good: Most compact at 252px; the short last note fits on one line, formulas and headers remain intact, and the table reads quickly.
critique.problems: 物理量 at 84px is the tightest of the three and leaves the long quantity name close to the cell padding; the one-line final row makes the bottom edge feel abruptly lighter than the three two-line rows above; 公式 at 112px has no slack.
critique.cause: Taking 179px for 说明 bought the one-line last row, but it came out of 物理量 (84px) and 公式 (112px), so the identifying column is cramped and the formula column is threshold-tight.

critique.good: Best overall balance: 物理量 still breaks 4+4, 公式 at 119px has about 7px slack, and 说明 at 172px keeps all body rows at two lines, producing even 60px rows and a calm grid.
critique.problems: 物理量 at 84px remains at its tight minimum; 公式 at 119px is slightly over-generous relative to the 91px longest formula, while 说明 at 172px is just below the one-line threshold for the shortest note, so row 4 wraps and the table stays 275px.
critique.cause: The extra 7px in 公式 improves math comfort but does not change line count; 说明 at 172px is the boundary that forces the last note onto a second line.

understanding.purpose: A compact physics reference table for looking up quantities, their symbols, defining formulas, SI units, and brief explanatory notes.
understanding.reading: Readers scan row by row from quantity to symbol, formula, and unit, then read the explanation; cross-row comparison concentrates on the formula and unit columns.
groups: Columns 1–2: quantity name and symbol together identify the row.
Columns 3–4: formula and unit together state the technical definition.
Column 5: explanatory prose that supports the row but is read after the formula.
keep_intact: Formula tokens and subscripts, especially unbreakable segments such as G·m₁m₂/r² and ½mv²
Symbols and units, including the em dash placeholders
Short headers 符号 and 单位
Quantity names where possible, though long names can wrap
may_wrap: 说明 prose, which can wrap naturally over several lines
Long quantity names such as 理想气体状态方程
Formulas at spaces or operators when the full expression cannot fit on one line

bad.why: It over-allocates 108px to 物理量 while starving 说明 at 155px; row 3's description breaks to 3 lines, creating an 83px row and a 299px table. The column hierarchy is inverted: the widest prose column is squeezed while a short-label column gets extra air.

final.rationale: r1B and r3B are effectively tied: both keep 符号/单位 at the 52px minimum, protect every formula with 112px, and give 说明 enough width (175–176px) that its longest entry is 2 lines while the last row remains 1 line. That yields a compact 252px table with a steady 36/60/60/60/36 rhythm. r1C is the clear failure because it spends 108px on 物理量 and leaves 说明 at 155px, forcing a 3-line cell and an 83px row. r2B is publishable but its 84px 物理量 column leaves only about 3px slack around 万有引力, so it is less robust.

general: Allocate width by content role, not equality: identifier/symbol columns should sit near their content minimum while the prose column gets the residual.
Protect formulas and identifiers from wrapping; a one-line formula column is worth more than extra whitespace in a short-label column.
Avoid letting a high-information prose column reach 3 lines while a low-entropy column is over-wide; that creates uneven row rhythm and inflates the table.
Chinese text wraps at character boundaries, so a phrase can be narrower than its full one-line width without mid-word splits, but tight fits around 4-character terms are fragile.
specific: 符号 and 单位 both need exactly 52px: 31px of content plus 21px padding/border.
公式 needs 112px so all formulas stay on one line; 116px adds harmless breathing room, beyond that is mostly waste.
物理量 works at 87–88px: 万有引力 stays on one line and 理想气体状态方程 wraps cleanly to two lines.
说明 needs about 175–176px to keep row 3 at two lines and the final row at one line; 155px pushes row 3 to three lines.

final.tradeoffs: The main tradeoff is 物理量 vs 说明: a wider first column calms the long Chinese term, but every pixel comes from the prose column and can push 说明 from 2 to 3 lines. A 275px version with all rows 60px is more airy and even, but it wastes vertical space without improving line breaks; the compact 252px layout is better for a reference table. There is also a choice between exact-fit 52px role columns and a few pixels of breathing room.
final.uncertain: Whether 84px for 物理量 is too tight is a judgment call; the exact 说明 threshold for keeping the last row on one line depends on font metrics and kerning. Reasonable designers may accept r2B for its wider prose column, or prefer the 275px layouts for their even row heights.
